---
title: "Data visualisation for evidence and insight"
subtitle: "Visualisations designed to reveal patterns, communicate evidence, and support data-driven reasoning."
description: |
  Data visualisation is more than a way to display results: it is a **powerful tool for exploration, interpretation, and reasoning**. Well-designed visualisations can **reveal hidden patterns, highlight meaningful differences, communicate uncertainty, and support data-driven decision-making**.

  The examples below illustrate different roles of data visualisation in scientific practice, from comparing groups and evaluating analytical strategies to uncovering unexpected behaviours in complex datasets. Together, they show how **visual representations can transform large amounts of information into evidence** that can be understood, questioned, and acted upon.

  Full-quality images, detailed legends, and references can be found in my PhD thesis [@LeSueurThesis].
